criteria.name: Energy performance
criteria.description: Primary energy consumption, energy savings, CO2 emissions reduction, and energy labeling of the building.
criteria.info: Overall energy efficiency of the building: energy consumption, energy savings, CO2 emissions and energy labeling.

criteria.name: Water use
criteria.description: Water consumption efficiency, wastewater reduction, and water reuse systems in building renovation.
criteria.info: Efficient use of water in the renovated building: consumption efficiency, wastewater reduction and water reuse systems.

criteria.name: Climate impact
criteria.description: Greenhouse gas emissions, carbon footprint, and climate resilience of the renovated building.
criteria.info: Effect of the building on the climate: greenhouse gas emissions, carbon footprint and resilience to climate change.

criteria.name: Economic performance
criteria.description: Investment costs, operational savings, payback period, NPV, IRR, and life-cycle cost analysis.
criteria.info: Financial viability of the renovation: investment costs, operational savings, payback period, net present value and life-cycle costs.

criteria.name: Indoor Environmental Quality (IEQ)
criteria.description: Thermal comfort, indoor air quality, visual comfort, and acoustic comfort for building occupants.
criteria.info: Quality of the indoor environment for occupants: thermal comfort, indoor air quality, visual comfort and acoustic comfort.

criteria.name: Energy system integration
criteria.description: Demand response, peak load reduction, load shifting, grid interaction, flexibility, and smart readiness indicators.
criteria.info: How well the building interacts with the energy system: demand response, peak load reduction, load shifting, grid interaction, flexibility and smart readiness.

criteria.name: Practical implementation
criteria.description: Practical implementation combining technical feasibility (constructability, technical complexity, maintenance requirements, technology readiness) with social impact (occupant satisfaction, social acceptance, equity, accessibility, and community benefits).
criteria.info: Feasibility in practice: technical aspects (constructability, complexity, maintenance, technology readiness) together with social impact (occupant satisfaction, acceptance, equity, accessibility, community benefits).
